parameters.optimizer: plain SGD (fixed step size, no momentum, no Adam)
parameters.advantage: one-step TD: A = r + γ·V(s') - V(s) (unclamped, the TD error δ)
parameters.actorDiscount: I = γ^t, reset to 1 every episode, applied to the actor only

rewards.proximity: gaussian(absDy / (scale.height/2), sigma=0.5), range [0, 1]; 0 when no pipe is ahead
